provenance.hashEvidenceBoundary: Retail-observed property ids originate in the xivl-captures packet corpus; captures publishes unresolved hashes by design.
provenance.resolution: This repository establishes each id-to-name pair by verifying that the name hashes to the retail-observed id with the backward MurmurHash2 implementation in tools/verify_murmur2.py.
provenance.payloadCrossCheck: tools/verify_murmur2.py checks every s2c 0x0137 sample property id from data/vendor/captures/payload_samples.json against this resolved set.
